newsitem.title: USA: PICO names Emley chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: PICO names Emley chairman, CEO.

text.p: Pico Products Inc Wednesday named Charles Emley Jr., currently chief operating officer, to the additional posts of chairman and chief executive officer.
Emley replaces Everett Keech, who resigned as chief executive officer and a director in order to pursue other opportunities. Keech will continue as a consultant.
Emley has been a director of the company since November 1993 and chief operating officer since March this year.
Most recently, Emley operated his own consulting firm in technology strategy, acquisitions and turnarounds.
